turns.learner: Hello! I need English for daily life here. Can we practise and, but and because?

planner.explanation: Task-based because B1 or above, partly secure or better, with a real-life goal; main method Formative Assessment & Feedback Loops because: Do the task, then feedback on one or two language errors.

turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes, we can practise this. These three small words make your English sound much more natural.

Quick question first: which of the words and, but and because do you already use when you write or speak English?

Our goal today: join two short sentences with and (add an idea), but (show a contrast) or because (give a reason).

Here is a model sentence from daily life (my own example): "I go to the market on Sunday because it is cheap."

Your task: write one sentence about your day using and, but or because. Choose the word you like best.
